summary: The modern clause has an open, downloadable dataset (BioTIME on Zenodo: abundance time series with a raw table and metadata, CC BY 4.0), and the geological clause has PBDB occurrences with age bounds from which occupancy per time bin can be computed. No dataset labels a form as 'favoured' or links one species' increase to another's decline, and PBDB has no abundance counts or sampling standardisation.
next_step: Pre-register separately: (a) BioTIME species pairs within assemblages for negative abundance coupling, (b) PBDB occupancy before last appearance with a sampling model.
obstacles_confirmed: Signor-Lipps effect needs a sampling model on PBDB.
Ecological series are short relative to extinction.
IUCN portal gave 403 and no API field list was seen.
